# Relizo

> Music release operations workspace for independent artists and labels to manage catalogs, releases, distributors, and promotion in one place.

Relizo is a single-user media asset manager built around the music release lifecycle. It organizes works, tracks, and albums; tracks release status across a calendar; and helps coordinate distribution and promotion channels. The app uses a left-sidebar navigation with a dashboard overview and dedicated sections for the music catalog, release planning, and distribution management.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Overview of releases, tasks, status distribution, and recent tracks.
- [Tracks](/tracks): Catalog of works and tracks with collapsible work trees and metadata.
- [Track Detail](/tracks/:id): Full metadata, audio preview, cover art, and version history for a track.
- [Add Track](/tracks/new): Form for creating a new track or work.
- [Albums](/albums): Album/EP listing and management.
- [Album Detail](/albums/:id): Album metadata, tracklist, and distribution details.
- [Releases](/releases): Release calendar and planning timeline.
- [Distributors](/distributors): Distribution partner management and channels.
- [Promotion](/promotion): Promotional task tracking and outreach.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth): Authentication page for existing and new accounts.
